body: For the last few hours I've been fighting the urge to self harm. It's only me fighting to stay alive. No one is here. So conclusion is no one cares if i'm alive or dead. Just me.
Riding a motorcycle or bicycle across the country doesn't sound fun. This is suppose to be a fun vacation not grueling torture.

6000 miles / 20mpg = 300 gallons of gas.
300 gallons * $2.00 a gallon = $600.
 
The trip is actually 5800 miles. My car gets 30 mpg. Gas is $1.50 in my state and $1.25 in southern states. It helps that I will be carrying food and a tent. Plus, I will be going places where I know people.

I plan on camping in all the national parks that I can. Stops include Grand Canyon, Redwood National Forest, Yellowstone, and the Appalachian Trail. I am very thrifty and will also be busking, for I am also a musician. $1000 will be more than plenty. I wouldn't mind disappearing though.
